item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Training margins are positive on average, but negatives outrank positives in 17.4–24.0% of sampled training pairs; Industrial_and_Scientific has the weakest separation.\",\"Deleting the final context item reduces training-target HR@10 by 6–16 percentage points across datasets. This indicates intervention sensitivity, but unsupported position and padding controls prevent attributing it specifically to recency.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Positive average margins coexist with substantial training-pair ranking errors.\",\"Embedding alignment scores near 0.5 indicate near-zero mean cosine, providing no evidence of directional collapse or recommendation diversity.\",\"These training-based diagnostics do not establish generalization; official validation accuracy is unavailable.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"training_negative_beats_positive_rate_range\":[0.174,0.24],\"Industrial_and_Scientific:pos_neg_margin_mean\":1.1163,\"Industrial_and_Scientific:pos_neg_margin_p10\":-0.7694,\"delete_final_training_hr10_drop_range\":[0.06,0.16],\"embedding_collapse_score_range\":[0.5028,0.5068]},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"training_negative_beats_positive_rate_range\":\"Fraction of sampled valid training pairs with negative margin.\",\"delete_final_training_hr10_drop_range\":\"Absolute declines on training targets; position and padding effects remain unresolved.\",\"embedding_collapse_score_range\":\"Transformed directional alignment, not proof of collapse.\"}}}"}
